description: Render one step's arm exactly as a recipient will receive it — server-side, through the SAME renderer the send path uses, so the preview cannot drift from the real message. ALWAYS preview every step before telling a human a campaign is ready. THREE FIELDS TO ACTUALLY READ: (1) `unresolved_merge_tags` lists tags that will render EMPTY on a live send — today every CRM tag except email is empty, so "Hi {{first_name}}" ships as "Hi ,", and nothing anywhere errors; (2) `continues_thread: true` with `subject: null` is the CORRECT state of a follow-up step, not a missing subject; (3) `postal_address` empty means this workspace has recorded none and the send will be refused — tell the human to fill in Settings → Information.

sample.description: A sample recipient to render the merge fields against.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
